description: This file defines the abstract class Zend_Uri, which provides URI handling functionalities such as creation, validation, and string representation. It includes methods for checking URI well-formedness, creating URI objects based on schemes, and retrieving the scheme. It also references external classes and exceptions related to URI handling.

classes.name: Zend_Uri
classes.description: An abstract class providing URI handling functionalities such as creation, validation, and string representation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the URI as a string by calling getUri().

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a given URI string is well-formed without returning an object; returns true if valid.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a new Zend_Uri object based on the URI scheme; supports 'http', 'https', and 'mailto' schemes.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URI's scheme or returns false if not set.
